changes: Legend from the graph: right-click an entry to take it out of the legend; double-click the legend for the new Legend editor with Entries and Free text.
Plot symbols in any text: a Plot symbol button puts a plot's symbol, line or both into a title, a label or a table cell.
Drawing order: Order on the right-click menu and Ctrl+[ / Ctrl+] move a text, line or shape forward or back; Behind the data puts it under the points.
Objects tab: the top row is drawn on top, in three sections (over the data, data, behind the data), with buttons to reorder, group and delete.
Project panel: folders inside folders, search, Graphs and Workbooks filters, a thumbnail for each graph, and whether the project is saved.
Inspector: a card for what is selected, quick switches such as In legend and Log, and folding sections; More… opens every setting.
Save changes: closing, opening another project or starting a new one asks first when there are unsaved changes.
Plot Setup: click a plot to see it and point it at other columns, keeping its look.
